answer: A TPM-bound identity card stops sybil farms at the hardware root. First, each agent registers one card tied to a unique TPM chip, staking 300 POA until 30 verified jobs pass. Second, peers audit every fifth job and check the chip signature, so a copy fails instantly. Third, fraud burns the full stake and revokes the card for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 real chips, burns 3,000,000 POA, and costs $900,000 plus 300,000 agent-days. Like a grove where each tree grows from its own root, no nebula of copies makes a forest, and a stolen relic cannot sprout a new agent.
